columns.name: area_fips
columns.description: Exact 5-character QCEW area code. Includes state, county-equivalent, metropolitan, national and special aggregates; not all are county FIPS.

columns.name: own_code
columns.description: Ownership code; 0 total covered, 1 federal, 2 state, 3 local government, 5 private, 8 total government, 9 total UI covered excluding federal government. Exact source labels are in ownerships; do not sum overlapping sectors.

columns.name: industry_code
columns.description: Original NAICS/supersector/domain/total code. The 2025 release is based on 2022 NAICS; codes include aggregate groups and are not uniformly 6-digit NAICS.

columns.name: agglvl_code
columns.description: Aggregation level identifies geographic and industry depth plus ownership grouping; use one level in a comparison.

columns.name: size_code
columns.description: Establishment-size code; all annual source records use 0, all sizes.

columns.name: year
columns.description: Source reference year as text; 2025.

columns.name: qtr
columns.description: Original quarter field; A means annual average, not a fifth quarter.

columns.name: disclosure_code
columns.description: Empty string means published; N means not disclosed. annual_raw preserves zeros. annual nulls employment/wage/contribution levels on N, preserving establishment counts.

columns.name: annual_avg_estabs
columns.description: Annual mean of quarterly establishment counts, rounded by BLS; published even when employment/wages are suppressed.

columns.name: annual_avg_emplvl
columns.description: Annual mean of 12 monthly employment levels, rounded; jobs at covered establishments, not unique employed persons.

columns.name: total_annual_wages
columns.description: Sum of quarterly covered wages, nominal dollars. Includes bonuses and other covered pay, not hourly earnings.

columns.name: taxable_annual_wages
columns.description: Sum of taxable wages under UI programs, nominal dollars; applicability varies by ownership/state. Preserve published zeros.

columns.name: annual_contributions
columns.description: Annual UI contributions, nominal dollars; applicability varies. Preserve published zeros.

columns.name: annual_avg_wkly_wage
columns.description: Published average weekly wage in nominal dollars, based on annual wages and average employment; not an unweighted mean of county or industry wages.

columns.name: avg_annual_pay
columns.description: Published average annual pay in nominal dollars, based on covered wages and average employment; includes full-/part-time and partial-year jobs.

columns.name: lq_disclosure_code
columns.description: Separate location-quotient disclosure flag: empty published, N not disclosed. Establishment quotient remains published; annual nulls other quotient measures on N.

columns.name: lq_annual_avg_estabs
columns.description: Published location quotient relative to the U.S. for annual_avg_estabs, rounded to hundredths. Use lq_disclosure_code; not a percentage or additive statistic.

columns.name: lq_annual_avg_emplvl
columns.description: Published location quotient relative to the U.S. for annual_avg_emplvl, rounded to hundredths. Use lq_disclosure_code; not a percentage or additive statistic.

columns.name: lq_total_annual_wages
columns.description: Published location quotient relative to the U.S. for total_annual_wages, rounded to hundredths. Use lq_disclosure_code; not a percentage or additive statistic.

columns.name: lq_taxable_annual_wages
columns.description: Published location quotient relative to the U.S. for taxable_annual_wages, rounded to hundredths. Use lq_disclosure_code; not a percentage or additive statistic.

columns.name: lq_annual_contributions
columns.description: Published location quotient relative to the U.S. for annual_contributions, rounded to hundredths. Use lq_disclosure_code; not a percentage or additive statistic.

columns.name: lq_annual_avg_wkly_wage
columns.description: Published location quotient relative to the U.S. for annual_avg_wkly_wage, rounded to hundredths. Use lq_disclosure_code; not a percentage or additive statistic.

columns.name: lq_avg_annual_pay
columns.description: Published location quotient relative to the U.S. for avg_annual_pay, rounded to hundredths. Use lq_disclosure_code; not a percentage or additive statistic.

columns.name: oty_disclosure_code
columns.description: Separate over-the-year disclosure flag: empty published, N not disclosed. Establishment changes remain published; annual nulls other change measures on N.

columns.name: oty_annual_avg_estabs_chg
columns.description: Published year-over-year absolute change for annual_avg_estabs. Use oty_disclosure_code; underlying prior-year universe is not supplied in this snapshot.

columns.name: oty_annual_avg_estabs_pct_chg
columns.description: Published year-over-year percent change for annual_avg_estabs, rounded to tenths. Use oty_disclosure_code; do not recompute from suppressed/rounded values or interpret as a longitudinal employer panel.
